verdict.rationale: Only community reports address licensing. They say LM Studio's license or terms of use do not permit work-related use (comm-8, comm-15), which tells a power-user that commercial use is restricted under the free terms. Nothing in the pack is first-party, and nothing says whether a paid commercial or enterprise license exists. Missing for 10: first-party license/terms documentation, a stated commercial or enterprise licensing path or pricing, and an explicit description of what the free edition permits.
